datasets.name: GDCLD landslide dataset
datasets.verbatim: The GDCLD landslide dataset is freely available at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.13612636 accessed on 24 October 2024.

methods.name: Lights-Transformer
methods.summary: A Transformer-based landslide detection model featuring an encoder-decoder architecture with an Overlap Patch Embedding, Efficient Self-Attention, Mix-FNN, Overlap Patch Merging, a Fusion Block for multi-scale feature integration, and a Light Segmentation Head for efficient inference.
methods.source: Xu Wu, Xuqing Ren, Donghao Zhai, Xiangpeng Wang, Mehreen Tarif

availability.author_statement: Data availability statement present with shared links.

reproducibility_assessment: The GDCLD landslide dataset is referenced and linked via a public Zenodo repository, but the custom Lights-Transformer model code is not available or linked.
